report.speaker: Thomas Lam
report.title: The Combinatorial Geometry of Particle Physics
report.arxiv_version_role: Versioned preprint for alternate access; the complete official SIAM mathematical body is canonical.
report.copyright: Copyright 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM. Official metadata confirms CC BY 4.0 and online publication on 2026-07-13. The Chinese reference page supplies attribution and identifies adaptation; supplemental arXiv distribution licenses are recorded separately.
report.question: How do positivity, oriented boundary residues and matroid face flags turn scattering amplitudes into canonical forms, polytope dual volumes and Laplace transforms, and where do conjectures still separate the general amplituhedron from proved examples?
report.reading_scope: Complete official SIAM report §§1-13, footnote, figure captions, relevant bibliography and publication/license metadata read beyond the abstract. Supplements were read only at the exact versioned sections, definitions, statements and selected proof passages listed in actual_reading and page_sources. Full supplemental proofs, and a second complete preprint-to-proceedings comparison, are not claimed.
report.coverage_status: 40 atomic knowledge pages, one substantive Chinese narrative outline and one reference page. Selected main-topic foundations and explicit calculations are developed; deeper research proofs and undeveloped report branches remain listed below.

proof_scope.2X01: Derives basis-change scaling, reconstructs a matrix on each nonzero Plucker chart, and counts real/complex dimensions. The complex extension is a general local construction, not a reuse of the specialized Nakajima example 2T0Y.
proof_scope.2X02: Proves Delta12 Delta34 - Delta13 Delta24 + Delta14 Delta23=0 by expansion; no general presentation of the Plucker ideal is claimed.
proof_scope.2X03: Verifies the rank axioms from dimensions, including a basis proof of dim(U+W)+dim(U intersect W)=dim U+dim W; identifies nonzero maximal minors with bases.
proof_scope.2X04: Defines positivity using one simultaneous Plucker sign, checks a matrix with a negative entry, and proves compactness by the orthogonal-projection matrix model and closedness.
proof_scope.2X05: Computes all six ordered maximal minors, solves the remaining strict inequality with a fourth positive parameter, and proves the resulting parameterization is bijective.
proof_scope.2X06: Defines positroids and their nonnegative cells; the positive-cell parameterization theorem is cited, not proved by constructing networks.
proof_scope.2X07: States the cyclic-interval rank description as an external theorem; directly computes a rank-one constraint example in a Gr(2,4) chart and distinguishes complex Zariski closure from real nonnegative closure.
proof_scope.2X08: States the closed-ball and regular CW theorems for REAL totally nonnegative positroid cell closures. Explains regularity and checks the rank-one interpretation; does not reconstruct the GKL proof or transfer the theorem to complex positroid varieties.
proof_scope.2X09: Proves Gr(1,n)>=0 is the standard simplex by normalizing the positive coordinate sum; identifies each support with a relative open face and its closure with a smaller simplex.
proof_scope.2X0A: Defines the image for n>=k+m and k,m>=1 with every ordered maximal minor of Z strictly positive. Rank preservation and full image dimension km are cited inputs; representative independence, compactness and the invertible n=k+m case are proved directly.
proof_scope.2X0B: Proves maximal-minor positivity by row subtraction, derives the convex-hull image, and proves every sampled parabola point is a vertex using its tangent line. Does not cite 120E as a Vandermonde theorem.
proof_scope.2X0C: Proves basis independence of the determinant zero locus and explains the four-dimensional quotient condition. The loci describe physical boundary types, not a complete proved face classification; the entire complex hypersurface is not identified with the real boundary.
proof_scope.2X0D: Defines RIGHT residue eta wedge df/f, proves independence of defining equation/decomposition locally, and checks the two iterated residue signs for dx wedge dy/(xy).
proof_scope.2X0E: Gives the recursive definition with normal irreducible real algebraic ambient variety, closed full-dimensional semialgebraic region, oriented smooth interior and unique nonzero rational top form. Records absence of nonboundary poles and the right-residue boundary orientation; no general existence theorem is inferred from the definition.
proof_scope.2X0F: Computes the interval form and signed endpoint residues, checks infinity in t=1/x, and proves uniqueness by the absence of a nonzero globally regular rational one-form on P1.
proof_scope.2X0G: Computes all three boundary residues with right-residue signs, checks projective infinity by a coordinate change, and proves uniqueness by the pole at infinity of a nonzero polynomial top form.
proof_scope.2X0H: Writes both triangle forms, computes cancellation at the internal diagonal, sums the rational functions and checks the square boundary residues. No general triangulation theorem is proved here.
proof_scope.2X0I: Defines pushforward on the finite unramified locus, explains coordinate invariance through inverse-branch pullback and rationality through trace. Computes x->x^2 with both complex branches; does not assert canonical-form preservation for an arbitrary map.
proof_scope.2X0J: Cites the full-dimensional convex-polytope canonical-form/dual-volume theorem. Independently computes triangle polar vertices, determinant and Euclidean area, fixing the mandatory d! normalization; checks dimension one. General polytope proof is not reproduced.
proof_scope.2X0K: Retains general positive geometry and the general closed-ball assertion as separate conjectures. Lists only the report's proved positive-geometry ranges k=1, m=1, k=m=2 and n=k+m. Does not upgrade all m=2 or m=4 cases to theorems.
proof_scope.2X0L: Proves the n row-sum equations are independent for n>=3, derives dimension n(n-3)/2, and proves X_S=X_(E\S). Distinguishes formal kinematics from additional fixed-dimensional Gram constraints.
proof_scope.2X0M: Defines the planar scalar tree sum, proves n-3 internal edges by the tree and valence equations, and lists the four- and five-point terms.
proof_scope.2X0N: Describes compatible diagonals and faces of the associahedron. Cites ABHY's special kinematic realization and amplitude/canonical-form identification; proves the four-point interval instance with s+t=c>0. Does not prove arbitrary affine sections realize the theorem.
proof_scope.2X0O: Derives the unique three-point normalization and n-3 local coordinates; defines the ordered positive chamber. Stable compactification and its associahedral positive geometry are cited geometric inputs, not reconstructed stable-curve theory.
proof_scope.2X0P: Proves the Beta-Gamma identity by a two-variable substitution and derives lim epsilon*B(epsilon*s,epsilon*t)=1/s+1/t for s,t>0. The general misprinted stringy formula (9.2) is deliberately not imported.
proof_scope.2X0Q: Proves the three linear identities among the equations from pairwise cancellation and row sums; solves the normalized four-point equation. The generic (n-3)! count is cited, not proved.
proof_scope.2X0R: Defines an essential distinct projective hyperplane arrangement, zero-sum weights and the master function; proves dlog(phi) descends and is a ONE-form. Generic finite nondegenerate critical points are an external input; zero weights give the explicit failure outside genericity.
proof_scope.2X0S: Proves coordinate invariance of h^2/det Hess at nondegenerate critical points. Computes the interval raw sum S=-(1/s+1/t), defines Acrit=(-1)^d*S and proves agreement in d=1 only. General equality with the flag sum or twisted intersection pairings is NOT asserted without reconciled global conventions.
proof_scope.2X0T: Defines the OS quotient and its reduced kernel for nonempty loopless rank r>=1 matroids, with right-deletion differential. Proves differential-square-zero and the contracting identity, and explains generation by differences. Top-degree and arrangement-cohomology identification are standard OS inputs, not reproved in full.
proof_scope.2X0U: Computes reduced degree-one OS as zero-sum coefficient vectors, proves adjacent differences form a basis and identifies their logarithmic forms with oriented interval forms.
proof_scope.2X0V: Defines the Las Vergnas face-flat lattice and the complete-flag rational sum, including zero total weight and empty product in rank one. The self-pairing identification is cited. Corrects the repeated-F_d denominator to product over F_i.
proof_scope.2X0W: Derives the two-endpoint formula, shows cancellation for a disconnected two-element example under a_E=0, and computes residues when the remaining weights are independent. Compares only with the explicitly normalized one-dimensional Hessian calculation.
proof_scope.2X0X: Proves the Laplace transform of a simplicial cone by a linear change of variables and product integration with Re a(v_i)>0. Includes the determinant exactly once and distinguishes ambient Euclidean from intrinsic/lattice-normalized measures.
proof_scope.2X0Y: Constructs flag cones in R^E/R*1 and the positive subfan; proves rank-1 dimension and unimodularity by layer-coordinate differences, and explains intersections via nested level sets. Does not identify arbitrary tropical varieties with such a fan.
proof_scope.2X0Z: Proves the rational Laplace transform equals the flag-defined amplitude, using unimodular cones and lower-dimensional intersections. Requires a common convergence chamber for an actual integral; otherwise defines the sum by cone-wise rational continuation.
proof_scope.2X10: Uses row-sum complement identities to translate channels and combines two of six flag terms into one, obtaining the five planar trees and cancellation at a+c=0.
proof_scope.2X11: Proves the 2-by-2 determinant model of the complex quadratic form and equivalence with nontrivial intersection of graph planes. The reverse endpoint construction explicitly excludes coincident consecutive intersection points; no degenerate inverse correspondence is claimed.
proof_scope.2X12: States the covector axioms, proves loopless topes have no zero entries and verifies composition/elimination for realizable arrangements. The equivalence between covector zero sets and a matroid flat lattice is a standard external input.
proof_scope.2X13: States the canonical tope element with an explicit compatible chirotope, right residue and contracted orientation. Gives only the triangulation/existence and residue-injectivity/uniqueness proof mechanism; does not present it as a full proof. Realization comparison is cited.
proof_scope.2X14: Cites the general connected-matroid residue-factorization and disconnected vanishing theorem. Proves flag factorization only under the additional condition E\F is not a face flat, explicitly explaining the complementary-divisor caveat. Proves at-most-simple poles and explains possible cancellation; does not equate every connected face flat with an actual pole.

2X0T.reading_scope: SIAM §11 read; supplemental OS definitions/differential conventions read. Hyperplane realization 2X0R is an application link, not a prerequisite for the formal quotient.
2X0T.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM). Named supplemental arXiv versions: perpetual non-exclusive distribution licenses; no CC license inferred. Notes paraphrase results and provide original calculations.
2X0T.proof_scope: Defines the OS quotient and its reduced kernel for nonempty loopless rank r>=1 matroids, with right-deletion differential. Proves differential-square-zero and the contracting identity, and explains generation by differences. Top-degree and arrangement-cohomology identification are standard OS inputs, not reproved in full.

2X0U.reading_scope: SIAM §11 and supplemental §2, selected §3 read; rank-two linear-independence proof supplied locally.
2X0U.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM). Named supplemental arXiv versions: perpetual non-exclusive distribution licenses; no CC license inferred. Notes paraphrase results and provide original calculations.
2X0U.proof_scope: Computes reduced degree-one OS as zero-sum coefficient vectors, proves adjacent differences form a basis and identifies their logarithmic forms with oriented interval forms.

2X0V.claim_sources: SIAM Theorem 10.3 and §11; Lam 2412.06705v1 §5.4 self-pairing theorem (Theorem 5.20).
2X0V.reading_scope: SIAM §§10-11 read; supplemental §5.4 selected formula/theorem passages read. Full intersection-pairing proof not reconstructed.
2X0V.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM). Named supplemental arXiv versions: perpetual non-exclusive distribution licenses; no CC license inferred. Notes paraphrase results and provide original calculations.
2X0V.proof_scope: Defines the Las Vergnas face-flat lattice and the complete-flag rational sum, including zero total weight and empty product in rank one. The self-pairing identification is cited. Corrects the repeated-F_d denominator to product over F_i.

2X0W.reading_scope: SIAM §§10-11 read; elementary flag sum and candidate-pole cancellation checked locally.
2X0W.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM); Chinese adaptation credited in icm2026-lam. Existing foundational notes are reused by links, not recopied.
2X0W.proof_scope: Derives the two-endpoint formula, shows cancellation for a disconnected two-element example under a_E=0, and computes residues when the remaining weights are independent. Compares only with the explicitly normalized one-dimensional Hessian calculation.

2X0X.reading_scope: SIAM §12 read; supplemental §10.2 selected Laplace definitions/formula read; determinant normalization independently derived.
2X0X.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM). Named supplemental arXiv versions: perpetual non-exclusive distribution licenses; no CC license inferred. Notes paraphrase results and provide original calculations.
2X0X.proof_scope: Proves the Laplace transform of a simplicial cone by a linear change of variables and product integration with Re a(v_i)>0. Includes the determinant exactly once and distinguishes ambient Euclidean from intrinsic/lattice-normalized measures.

2X0Y.claim_sources: SIAM Definition 12.1 and following positive fan; Lam 2412.06705v1 §§10.1,10.6.
2X0Y.reading_scope: SIAM §12 read; supplemental flag lattice/cone and positive subfan definitions read.
2X0Y.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM). Named supplemental arXiv versions: perpetual non-exclusive distribution licenses; no CC license inferred. Notes paraphrase results and provide original calculations.
2X0Y.proof_scope: Constructs flag cones in R^E/R*1 and the positive subfan; proves rank-1 dimension and unimodularity by layer-coordinate differences, and explains intersections via nested level sets. Does not identify arbitrary tropical varieties with such a fan.

2X0Z.reading_scope: SIAM §12 read; selected supplemental fan/Laplace definitions read; term-by-term proof supplied locally.
2X0Z.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM). Named supplemental arXiv versions: perpetual non-exclusive distribution licenses; no CC license inferred. Notes paraphrase results and provide original calculations.
2X0Z.proof_scope: Proves the rational Laplace transform equals the flag-defined amplitude, using unimodular cones and lower-dimensional intersections. Requires a common convergence chamber for an actual integral; otherwise defines the sum by cone-wise rational continuation.

2X10.reading_scope: SIAM §§8-10 read; six-term/five-term identity and channel substitutions checked directly.
2X10.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM); Chinese adaptation credited in icm2026-lam. Existing foundational notes are reused by links, not recopied.
2X10.proof_scope: Uses row-sum complement identities to translate channels and combines two of six flag terms into one, obtaining the five planar trees and cancellation at a+c=0.

2X11.reading_scope: SIAM §4 read; determinant and graph-plane calculations supplied locally.
2X11.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM); Chinese adaptation credited in icm2026-lam. Existing foundational notes are reused by links, not recopied.
2X11.proof_scope: Proves the 2-by-2 determinant model of the complex quadratic form and equivalence with nontrivial intersection of graph planes. The reverse endpoint construction explicitly excludes coincident consecutive intersection points; no degenerate inverse correspondence is claimed.

2X12.claim_sources: SIAM §11; Lam 2412.06705v1 §3.5, with standard covector axioms stated in full.
2X12.reading_scope: SIAM §11 read; supplemental covector/topes discussion read. Full equivalence of oriented-matroid axiom systems not reconstructed.
2X12.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM). Named supplemental arXiv versions: perpetual non-exclusive distribution licenses; no CC license inferred. Notes paraphrase results and provide original calculations.
2X12.proof_scope: States the covector axioms, proves loopless topes have no zero entries and verifies composition/elimination for realizable arrangements. The equivalence between covector zero sets and a matroid flat lattice is a standard external input.

2X13.claim_sources: Eur-Lam 2502.20782v1 Theorem 2.4, Corollary 2.9, selected §3.2 geometric comparison; SIAM §11.
2X13.reading_scope: SIAM §11 read; supplemental §2 definitions, Theorem 2.4 proof mechanism, Corollary 2.9 statement/proof and selected §3.1-3.2 read. Later basis/Aomoto proofs not read.
2X13.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM). Named supplemental arXiv versions: perpetual non-exclusive distribution licenses; no CC license inferred. Notes paraphrase results and provide original calculations.
2X13.proof_scope: States the canonical tope element with an explicit compatible chirotope, right residue and contracted orientation. Gives only the triangulation/existence and residue-injectivity/uniqueness proof mechanism; does not present it as a full proof. Realization comparison is cited.

2X14.claim_sources: SIAM Theorem 11.4; Lam 2412.06705v1 Theorem 17.4 and Remark 17.5.
2X14.reading_scope: SIAM §11 read; supplemental Theorem 17.4 proof and Remark 17.5 selected passages read. The unrestricted comparison/factorization proof is not reconstructed locally.
2X14.license: Main report: CC BY 4.0 (IMU/SIAM). Named supplemental arXiv versions: perpetual non-exclusive distribution licenses; no CC license inferred. Notes paraphrase results and provide original calculations.
2X14.proof_scope: Cites the general connected-matroid residue-factorization and disconnected vanishing theorem. Proves flag factorization only under the additional condition E\F is not a face flat, explicitly explaining the complementary-divisor caveat. Proves at-most-simple poles and explains possible cancellation; does not equate every connected face flat with an actual pole.

remaining_branches: Postnikov network parameterizations, plabic/on-shell graph moves and positive Grassmannian cell theory are cited, not reconstructed.

Knutson-Lam-Speyer normality, Cohen-Macaulayness, intersection/cohomology and Stanley-symmetric-function formulas for complex positroid varieties are not developed into proofs. Complex varieties are not assigned the real closed-ball theorem.
Galashin-Karp-Lam closed-ball and regular CW proofs are external. The notes explicitly apply them only to the real totally nonnegative positroid cell closures.

General amplituhedron rank preservation and dimension are external inputs. Positive geometry remains SIAM Conjecture7.3 in general; the general closed-ball assertion is a separate conjecture. No complete face stratification or all-m=4 amplitude/canonical-form identification is proved.
General BCFW/on-shell constructions, supersymmetric variables, physical normalization and positive-helicity amplitude formulas in §§3-6 are narrative context only.

General positive-geometry existence, triangulation independence, polytope dual-volume and special amplituhedron theorems are cited; elementary interval, triangle, square and polar calculations are fully written.
The full ABHY associahedron realization and its canonical-form identification, stable M0n compactification and the generic (n-3)! scattering-solution count remain cited inputs.

The general stringy-integral formula (9.2) is not imported because of displayed domain/index/prefactor issues; only the independently derived positive-real four-point Beta limit is covered. Original general stringy-integral source was not read.

The direct critical-point Hessian sum has an explicit overall sign discrepancy in dimension one against the positive flag normalization. 2X0S proves only the one-dimensional signed comparison and coordinate invariance; general twisted de Rham/intersection comparison awaits uniform convention reconciliation.

Orlik-Solomon top-degree/cohomology theorem and equivalence of covector/chirotope axiom systems are external standard foundations. Formal quotient definitions and elementary rank-two calculations are provided.
Eur-Lam canonical tope existence/uniqueness is stated with recursive orientation data and a proof mechanism, not a reconstructed triangulation proof. Later basis and Aomoto results are not developed.

Lam's general residue-factorization and decomposable vanishing theorem remains an external input. 2X14 proves the flag-splitting argument only with the additional no-complementary-face hypothesis and separately proves at-most-simple poles.

General tropical-variety transforms, dual matroid volumes, discrete Laplace and stringy intersection pairings from §§12-13 are not developed. The Gao-Lam-Xue discrete dual-volume work is announced/in preparation in the report and is not upgraded to an established theorem.

source_errata.issue: Rank-one positroid varieties are described as coordinate hyperplanes.
source_errata.treatment: 2X09 uses arbitrary nonempty coordinate supports, hence coordinate projective subspaces; only codimension-one supports give hyperplanes.

source_errata.issue: Joining consecutive intersection points requires those points to be distinct.
source_errata.treatment: 2X11 explicitly restricts the reverse construction to the nondegenerate open locus, and distinguishes coincident lines from a unique intersection point.

source_errata.issue: The dual-volume display depends on the volume normalization.
source_errata.treatment: 2X0J uses ordinary Euclidean volume with the factor d!, or normalized volume Vol=d!*vol_Euc. Triangle determinant and interval calculation fix the convention. Linear inequality slack is not called unit-normal distance.

source_errata.issue: Displayed general stringy integral appears to omit (alpha')^d, gives R^d instead of the positive orthant and repeats coefficient index c_i in place of c_j.
source_errata.treatment: General formula not used. 2X0P proves only the four-point Beta integral for s,t,epsilon>0, with the necessary epsilon prefactor. No unverified replacement general formula is asserted.
2X0R gives the coordinate expression and proves it is a one-form, independently of d.

source_errata.issue: Printed product repeats F_d rather than using the indexed F_i.
source_errata.treatment: 2X0V uses product_i a_(F_i), checked against Lam2412.06705v1 §5.4.

source_errata.location: Definition10.2; supplemental Definition16.2 versus positive flag normalization
source_errata.issue: With Phi=s log x+t log(1-x), the unmodified h^2/Hessian sum is -(1/s+1/t).
source_errata.treatment: 2X0S retains raw S and separately defines Acrit=(-1)^d*S. Only coordinate invariance and the d=1 comparison are proved; a general convention-fixed identification is deferred.

source_errata.issue: The determinant appears inside a repeated product in the inspected source display.
source_errata.treatment: 2X0X derives the change-of-variables factor once. 2X0Y-Z use intrinsic lattice-normalized measure on each cone span, not ambient high-dimensional Lebesgue measure.

source_errata.issue: OS boundary and geometric residue conventions must be coordinated; opposite conventions can have degree-dependent signs.
source_errata.treatment: 2X0D,T,13 explicitly use right-side residues and right-deletion boundary. The interval orientation is fixed as +dx. No silent convention identification is used.

source_errata.issue: Complementary face sums satisfy a_(E\F)=-a_F; flag terms through a complementary face cannot be discarded termwise without further argument.
source_errata.treatment: 2X14 cites the full theorem but restricts its locally supplied flag-splitting proof to E\F not in L(P), retaining general simple-pole and cancellation caveats.
